input: Original 16-cell overview, 8 clips x4 frames; policy JSON 8 integers 0..100; original mean aggregation, illegal windows zero included
teacher_question: Given the whole-video overview and the two clips, which clip would you retain in a short highlight reel of this video? Judge the significance and viewing value of the visible moment in this video's context. Motion, rarity, static appearance, or repetition alone does not determine value. A: the first clip is more valuable. B: the second clip is more valuable. C: their highlight value is similar. D: the visual evidence is insufficient to decide. Answer with one letter only.
teacher_dtype: BF16, batch1, no quantization, last-position logits

technical.top_rule: unique argmax; C tied with D is insufficient for correct tie
technical.view_cache: exact prompt, overview/frame bytes, teacher revision and processor identity

edge_rules.unknown: D, order conflict, low mass/margin or ambiguity; never a negative label

reward: Kept-edge weighted order agreement 1/.5/0, invalid JSON -1, legal/no edge .5

train_pool.u: mean directional weight * directional clip coverage /8
train_pool.source_balancing: randomized source cycles; window draws with replacement; common 320-prefix

optimization.DPO_logp: SUM over all actual generated completion tokens including actual EOS; no prompt
optimization.reference: Frozen original common S0 by disabling all fresh LoRA
optimization.all_zero_u_batch: skip optimizer and scheduler; never change momentum
optimization.technical_checks: Separate discarded four-step DPO and four-step guard adapters; eight optimizer calls total, charged to student technical budget
optimization.DPO_continuation: restore adapter/optimizer/scheduler/RNG after80, continue81..320; no endpoint AP read until all four frozen

decision.teacher_only_signal_rule: Both RL fail; stronger DPO beats S0 by at least1pp and at least6/10 sources improve; project label, not significance

human_labels: No training human values; teacher/candidate rewards frozen before isolated dev evaluator reads cached H/ratings
known_89_conflicts: final fixed-case review only; never used for inputs, question or admission

failure_case_reporting_rules.interface: First3 failed same-clip pairs sorted by source/clip
failure_case_reporting_rules.reward: Lowest single-window G, max1/source, ties requestID, first3
failure_case_reporting_rules.final: Worst3 source AP differences versus stronger whole-macro DPO for each RL; report positive values if fewer than3 failures
